themeTokenRules.reason: accents are only used by the light case hero

rawValueRestrictions.color: RAW_COLOR: no #hex / rgb() / hsl() literal anywhere in a PageSpec
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: no spacing field exists on a PageSpec node (schema additionalProperties:false); spacing is owned by section contracts
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: no font field exists on a PageSpec node; the only family is pleasure

overrides: PageSpecs carry exactly one token slot (hero.case style.accent). Spacing, type and radius are fixed by section contracts; there is no per-instance override mechanism in the source, so none is offered.
